# Explore Intouch Navigation

The Capillary Platform brings all products into a single interface with one shared navigation panel. You can use the navigation panel on the left to access the modules. Navigate to a module to open it and access its features.

The navigation panel provides access to the following modules:

<HTMLBlock>{`

  <style>
    :root {
      --page-bg: #ffffff;
      --tile-bg: #F9F9F9;
      --tile-border: #dddddd;
      --tile-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
      --tile-text: #333333;
      --icon-color: #4a4a4a;
      --active-border: #b9b9b9;
      --active-bg: #eeeeee;
    }

    @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
      :root {
        --page-bg: #121212;
        --tile-bg: #262626;
        --tile-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
        --tile-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
        --tile-text: #f0f0f0;
        --icon-color: #e6e6e6;
        --active-border: #6b6b6b;
        --active-bg: #333333;
      }
    }

    /* Manual overrides for apps that toggle theme via attribute instead of OS setting */
    [data-theme="dark"] {
      --page-bg: #121212;
      --tile-bg: #262626;
      --tile-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
      --tile-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
      --tile-text: #f0f0f0;
      --icon-color: #e6e6e6;
      --active-border: #6b6b6b;
      --active-bg: #333333;
    }

    [data-theme="light"] {
      --page-bg: #ffffff;
      --tile-bg: #F9F9F9;
      --tile-border: #dddddd;
      --tile-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
      --tile-text: #333333;
      --icon-color: #4a4a4a;
      --active-border: #b9b9b9;
      --active-bg: #eeeeee;
    }

    body {
      margin: 0 !important;
      padding: 0 !important;
      font-family: sans-serif !important;
      text-align: left !important;
      background-color: var(--page-bg) !important;
    }

    .grid {
      display: grid !important;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr) !important;
      grid-auto-rows: 1fr !important;
      gap: 16px !important;
      padding: 20px !important;
      box-sizing: border-box !important;
      text-align: left !important;
    }

    .tile {
      background-color: var(--tile-bg) !important;
      padding: 0 !important;
      border-radius: 8px !important;
      border: 1px solid var(--tile-border) !important;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 6px var(--tile-shadow) !important;
      transition: background-color 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease !important;
      text-align: left !important;
      position: static !important;
      overflow: hidden !important;
      height: 100% !important;
      box-sizing: border-box !important;
    }

    .tile a {
      display: flex !important;
      align-items: center !important;
      text-decoration: none !important;
      color: var(--tile-text) !important;
      width: 100% !important;
      height: 100% !important;
      text-align: left !important;
      padding: 16px !important;
      margin: 0 !important;
      position: static !important;
      transition: background-color 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease !important;
      border-radius: 8px !important;
      box-sizing: border-box !important;
    }

    .tile span {
      font-size: 1em !important;
      font-weight: 500 !important;
      margin-left: 10px !important;
      white-space: nowrap !important;
      overflow: hidden !important;
      text-overflow: ellipsis !important;
      text-align: left !important;
      padding: 0 !important;
      display: inline-block !important;
      vertical-align: middle !important;
      min-width: 0 !important;
    }

    .icon {
      width: 20px !important;
      height: 20px !important;
      min-width: 20px !important;
      object-fit: contain !important;
      display: inline-block !important;
      vertical-align: middle !important;
      margin: 0 !important;
      padding: 0 !important;
      color: var(--icon-color) !important;
      flex-shrink: 0 !important;
    }

    .tile:hover {
      transform: scale(1.02) !important;
    }

    .tile a:hover {
      background-color: var(--active-bg) !important;
    }

    .tile[data-active="true"] {
      border-color: var(--active-border) !important;
      background-color: var(--active-bg) !important;
    }
  </style>
</head>

# **Home**

The **Home** page provides an overview of activity across your organization and quick access to key resources.

The following table describes the areas available in the Home module:

| Area                 | What it shows                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| :------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **aiRA**             | An AI assistant is available on the Homepage. You can type a question or select a suggested prompt, such as **Pick a starting point**, **Program Health**, or **Trend Analysis**, to get started. |
| **Recent sessions**  | Quick access to your recent aiRA sessions. Select **View all** to view your complete session history.                                                                                             |
| **Currently active** | A live count of active items across key modules, including Promotions, Programs, Journeys, Campaigns, Coupon series, and Badges.                                                                  |
| **Resource Column**  | Links to **New releases**, **Documentation**, **Capillary Academy**, **Blog**, and the Capillary Technologies website.                                                                            |

<Image src="https://files.readme.io/a1a239cfb56580eeeeea33baa8b067e59b37f60b31a9dc550e88b8aff2ebf3fa-image.png" border={true} />

# **aiRA**

aiRA is Capillary's built-in AI assistant. Use it to ask questions about your programs, campaigns, and customer data, get quick answers, and run analysis without switching between modules. What aiRA can help with depends on your role and access within your organization. Select **aiRA** in the navigation rail to expand it and access the following:

| Sub-section                                                                                                                        | What you can do                                                                                                                                                              |
| :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| <Anchor target="_blank" href="https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/aira-getting-started#start-a-conversation">**New chat**</Anchor> | Start a new aiRA conversation. Enter a question, or choose a suggested prompt: **Pick a starting point**, **Program health**, or **Trend analysis**.                         |
| <Anchor target="_blank" href="https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/aira-getting-started#sessions">**Sessions**</Anchor>             | View and search your past aiRA conversations. Pin the ones you use often for quick access.                                                                                   |
| <Anchor target="_blank" href="https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/aira-getting-started#apps">**Apps**</Anchor>                     | View and manage the dashboards and reports generated from your chats                                                                                                         |
| <Anchor target="_blank" href="https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/aira-getting-started#settings">**Settings**</Anchor>             | Configure aiRA for your organization: manage the context information aiRA uses to give more relevant answers, allowlist URLs, monitor usage, and manage billing and credits. |

<Image src="https://files.readme.io/772671b3aa7d329fe4a17c63bd1352b17a1368b1cf5a31e4944ab4a94055b573-airaa.gif" border={true} />

# **Loyalty**

Loyalty is where you set up how you reward customers for doing business with you. Use it to enroll customers into a program that rewards them over time, and to run promotions that add short-term incentives along with that program.

The table below breaks down what each subsection is and what you can use it for:

| Sub section                                                                                                                             | What you can do                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| <Anchor target="_blank" href="https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/create-a-multi-loyalty-program#getting-started">**Programs**</Anchor> | Create and manage ongoing loyalty programs. Set up how customers earn rewards, configure points expiry, and manage tiers and other program-specific settings.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| <Anchor target="_blank" href="https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/loyalty-promotions">**Promotions**</Anchor>                           | Create and manage time-bound loyalty promotions along with reward specific customer actions with bonus points, coupons, milestones, or streaks, and configure promotion-specific settings. <br /><br />**Note:** If your organization was created before January 2026, you will be on the old Promotions UI by default. To navigate to the new Promotions UI, select **Go to new promotions (v3)** in the top-right corner of the promotions listing page. |

**Note:** You can access **Milestones** and **Streaks**  through **Organization Settings** or directly using the following URLs:

* <Anchor target="_blank" href="https://eu.intouch.capillarytech.com/tesseract/ui/milestones">Milestones</Anchor>
* <Anchor target="_blank" href="https://eu.intouch.capillarytech.com/tesseract/ui/streaks">Streaks</Anchor>

All loyalty-specific configurations are available in the **Settings** of each subsection.

<Image src="https://files.readme.io/c5a3795154150fbe6939ff6ec17c7ab0a4c3b00a8989ce83993c64f0e916579e-loyalty.gif" border={true} />

# **Engage**

Engage is where you reach out to customers with campaigns and automated journeys. Use campaigns to send one-time or scheduled marketing messages across engagement channels. You can use journeys to automatically guide customers through a personalized flow based on specific events, like sending a reminder when they abandon a cart, or a reward after they make a purchase.

The table below breaks down what each subsection is and what you can use it for:

| Sub section                                                                                                   | What you can use it for                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| <Anchor target="_blank" href="https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/campaign-management">**Campaigns**</Anchor> | Create, schedule, and send customer communication campaigns. You can also attach cart promotions or gift vouchers to your campaigns and configure campaign-specific options, such as link tracking, tag formatting, and communication limits, from **Settings**.                                             |
| <Anchor target="_blank" href="https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/journey-management">**Journeys**</Anchor>   | You can set up automated customer journeys that move customers down different paths based on specific events. You can also choose how many times a customer can enter the same journey. You can also set an exit condition, so customers stop getting messages once they've done what you wanted them to do. |

All engage-specific configurations are available in the **Settings** of each subsection.

<Image src="https://files.readme.io/dcbe14a23ebfceac2bc4be78d27d61308e76bf486577b0ec0e21fd8b41adfafc-Engage.gif" border={true} />

# **Rewards**

Rewards lets you issue incentives to customers, such as coupons, badges based on customer achievements, and a catalog of items customers can redeem with their points or cash.

The table below breaks down what each subsection is and what you can use it for:

| Sub section                                                                                                            | What you can use it for                                                                                                                                    |
| :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| <Anchor target="_blank" href="https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/offers-coupons">Coupons</Anchor>                     | Create and manage coupon offers that customers apply at checkout, online or in-store, to get a discount on specific products, categories, or order values. |
| <Anchor target="_blank" href="https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/customer_badges">Badges</Anchor>                     | Create and manage badges that customers can earn through specific actions, or achievements                                                                 |
| <Anchor target="_blank" href="https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/incentives-rewards-catalog">Rewards Catalog</Anchor> | Manage rewards catalog, which lets customers purchase rewards such as vouchers, gift cards using points or cash.                                           |

All reward-specific configurations are available in the **Settings** of each subsection.

<Image src="https://files.readme.io/7a381320127871ea14cc27f9e100158f10cb33a083d3a446b76594f3d66a3697-Rewards.gif" border={true} />

# **Audiences**

Create and manage <Anchor target="_blank" href="https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/audience-management">audience</Anchor> groups that determine who receives your campaigns and journeys. Audiences you create here can be reused across campaigns, journeys, promotions, rewards, and more.

<Image src="https://files.readme.io/54fb9f4a4d57e0a1c439e18b9cb3884a06be9def5b49ec5053c39d01fa6591e3-audience.gif" border={true} />

# **Channels**

Configure the engagement channels you want to use to reach your customers. You can then create templates for each channel and reuse them across your campaigns and journeys.

The table below breaks down what each subsection is and what you can use it for:

| Sub section                                                                                               | What you can use it for                                                                                                               |
| :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| <Anchor target="_blank" href="https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/engagement-channels">Creatives</Anchor> | Create and manage templates for specific engagement channels, and reuse them across your campaigns and journeys.                      |
| Channel Setup                                                                                             | Set up the account for any engagement channel whose gateway is already available but hasn't been configured for your organization yet |

All channel-specific configurations are available in the **Settings** of each subsection.

<Image src="https://files.readme.io/1018ca4cc39af7cb4c847072ad9204940ce577fea06a62b12415be1b628c6f5a-channels.gif" border={true} />

# **Member Care**

Customer service tools for viewing customer information, handling requests, and accessing organization-specific applications.

The table below breaks down what each subsection is and what you can use it for:

| Sub section                                                                                                  | What you can use it for                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| <Anchor target="_blank" href="https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/member-care-new-ui">Member Search</Anchor> | Search for customer profiles and view customer information. You can configure Member Care extensions and related preferences from the member search **Settings**.                                       |
| Requests                                                                                                     | Manage customer service requests. Each request type appears as a separate tab, with status filters available within each tab. Configure request workflow mappings from the member request **Settings**. |

All membercare-specific configurations are available in the **Settings** of each subsection.

**Note:** If your organization uses custom applications within Member Care, or Member Care itself is deployed as a custom application, it may temporarily open in a separate browser tab until the UI library is upgraded. To have these applications rendered within the same app with the new navigation, contact your Capillary point of contact (POC).

<Image src="https://files.readme.io/716610847f3a60be1ed59da879523360cff7857663008cefc4d7cd4884167984-membercare.gif" border={true} />

# **Insights**

Analyze loyalty, campaign, and customer activity through reports and saved analytics assets.

The table below breaks down what each subsection is and what you can use it for:

| Sub section                                                                                                | What you can use it for                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| <Anchor target="_blank" href="https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/reports-and-charts">Reports</Anchor>     | Run, schedule, and manage reports. Use filters such as module, report type, and category to quickly locate reports. Configure report templates, dimensions, and Power BI integration from the reports **Settings**. |
| Library                                                                                                    | Access saved report templates and shared reporting assets.                                                                                                                                                          |
| <Anchor target="_blank" href="https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/customer-segmentation">Segments</Anchor> | View and manage customer segments. Filter the listing by active or inactive status.                                                                                                                                 |

All insights-specific configurations are available in the **Settings** of each subsection.

**Note:** Filters are available for the **Reports** listing page. Use the module, report type, and category filters to quickly locate reports, and the active/inactive status filter on **Segments**

<Image src="https://files.readme.io/725ab711e9ad4506ed887f9cdc0a31332641c01610c97caeead2cd2d3e900c54-Insights.gif" border={true} />

# **Data Management**

A central hub for all data entities and data operations across the platform.

The table below breaks down what each subsection is and what you can use it for:

| Sub section                                                                                                                  | What you can use it for                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| <Anchor target="_blank" href="https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/data-entities">Entities</Anchor>                           | Manage all data entities in one place - customers, transactions, products, locations (stores, tills, zones, concepts), custom fields, extended fields, payment modes, behavioural events, cards, group hierarchies, and search filters. |
| <Anchor target="_blank" href="https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/connect-plus">Dataflows</Anchor>                           | Create and manage data integration flows. This section was previously known as Connect+, which has been renamed to Dataflows.                                                                                                           |
| <Anchor target="_blank" href="https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/data-import-new">Imports</Anchor>                          | Import data into the platform.                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| <Anchor target="_blank" href="https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/export">Exports</Anchor>                                   | Export data from the platform. Manage FTP credentials, servers, and public keys from the module's **Settings**.                                                                                                                         |
| <Anchor target="_blank" href="https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/configure_event_notification">Event Notifications</Anchor> | Configure notifications triggered by specific data events.                                                                                                                                                                              |

All data management-specific configurations are available in the **Settings** of each subsection.

<Image src="https://files.readme.io/60f5f2b7fb1424047cafce4396b18ad1d141fd91a9b311f74cb677c78a381cbc-data_mangement.gif" border={true} />

# **Extensions**

Developer tools for extending the platform and integrating external systems.

The table below breaks down what each subsection is and what you can use it for:

| Sub section                                                                                         | What you can use it for                                                                             |
| :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| <Anchor target="_blank" href="https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/extension">API Extension</Anchor> | Build and manage API-based extensions. This section was previously known as Neo Extension.          |
| <Anchor target="_blank" href="https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/vulcan">UI Extension</Anchor>     | Build and manage custom user interface extensions. This section was previously known as Vulcan.     |
| <Anchor target="_blank" href="https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/dev-console">Dev Console</Anchor> | Access the developer console for testing and exploration. Availability depends on your permissions. |

<Image src="https://files.readme.io/17811998d71bd2123ec24754392654cd0961e09e233aa30a9f374b77b3f5170a-extension.gif" border={true} />

# **Settings**

Manage organization-wide preferences and administrative configurations. Unlike module-specific settings, these configurations apply across the entire organization.

<Image src="https://files.readme.io/928f1c31ca23ed32f18888a42d88067047bd41cd6f7c96f6e4858df43ab9f494-organization_settings.gif" border={true} />

# **Your profile menu**

Click your profile icon in the upper-right corner to access:

* **Your profile preferences –** View and update your profile details and preferences, such as your name, language, preferred organization, and preferred module.
* **Manage Users** – Add, edit, and manage user accounts and role assignments. Only admins and organization owners can access this.
* **Documentation** – Access Capillary product documentation.
* **Capillary Academy** – Access training and learning resources.

<Image src="https://files.readme.io/b19a9907c3b9bac90aedb22885e9353206396425e8f6e4dbe22767eee38a7118-profile_menu.gif" border={true} />

# **Switching between ui versions**

Some modules are available in both the new and classic interfaces. These modules open in the new interface by default.

If you need the classic interface, use the switch button in the module header. The classic interface opens in a new browser tab, allowing you to continue working in the new interface without losing your place.

Modules that currently support both interfaces include:

* Loyalty Promotions
* Campaigns
* Member Care
* Dataflows (formerly Connect+)
* Imports

# **Roles and permissions**

Your existing roles and permissions remain unchanged.

The navigation does not change who can access what; this is still governed by your org's role-based access control (RBAC) configuration under User management.

All sections and modules are visible in the navigation rail. If you do not have access to a specific section or module, a **No access** message is displayed when you try to open it. Contact your org administrator, or go to **Manage users** from the profile menu to review role assignments.
